[cheerful] Since the start of module 8, you’ve been building the database for NutriBoost’s wellness workshops.

In the previous lesson, you added rows with insert into.

In the fall, you get three requests by email to update NutriBoost’s data.

To handle them, you’ll change information in existing rows with the SQL command UPDATE.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] The Pilates workshop’s date is in the workshops table.

Your turn!

With UPDATE, you choose the table to change.

With SET, you give the column to change and its new value.

With where, you select the row to change.

Your turn!
